assets.prompt: 2000x1400 landscape. One faded worn-out orange mitochondrion with irregular cristae on the right, matching reference organelle, and a small round pale-rose lysosome one third its length on the left, single smooth membrane and small darker enzyme granules. Mitochondrion is already enclosed in a separate thin pale autophagosome membrane, clearly not the mitochondrion's own envelope; lysosome nearby not yet fused. This supplies the wrapping membrane referred to in the requested after-state and avoids implying direct lysosome engulfment of a bare mitochondrion. Very pale local cytoplasm wash only immediately around both organelles, otherwise transparent. Keep simple horizontal arrangement for an aligned after-state. Scientific-educational asset, fine dark ink and layered watercolour matching the reference, transparent PNG true alpha, 10 percent clear margin. Clean neutral antialiased edges, NO fluorescent red magenta yellow fringe, NO glow. No text, letters, numbers, labels, arrows, scale bars, people, hands, faces, brand or backdrop.

assets.name: y11-lysosome-after-v1.png
assets.localEdits: Isotropically registered degraded organelle to the same shared box and centre as before; the fused sac replaces the separate lysosome. No duplicate intact organelle remains.
assets.prompt: Edit this exact before-state into its aligned after-state, preserving canvas 1753x897, mitochondrion centre, size, viewpoint and palette. The small rose lysosome at left has FUSED with the pre-existing pale membrane wrapping the mitochondrion at right. Now a single ROSE membrane sac surrounds the partly broken-down mitochondrion at SAME right-hand location; the separate left lysosome no longer exists. Mitochondrial edges fragment and irregular cristae dissolve into granules inside the rose sac. Keep all changes local to those two organelles; no repositioning of the main mitochondrion. Transparent background, no shadow. This pair will be checked by overlay. Fine dark ink and layered watercolour school-science plate on TRUE transparent background, 10 percent clear margin, clean edges with no coloured fringe, no glow or ground shadow, no text labels numbers arrows scales brand people hands faces.
